question: Which of the following state government has planned to develop Jhajjar-Bachauli wildlife sanctuary as first leopard safari destination in the state?
solution: The correct answer is __**Punjab**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Jhajjar-Bachauli Wildlife Sanctuary** in Punjab is set to be developed as the state’s **first leopard safari destination**, aiming to boost tourism and wildlife conservation. • This initiative is part of Punjab's efforts to promote **eco-tourism** while ensuring the protection of wildlife in their natural habitats. • The sanctuary is located in the **Rupnagar district of Punjab**, and it is known for its diverse flora and fauna, including leopards and other wildlife species. • The leopard safari will be designed to provide visitors with an opportunity to observe leopards in a secure and controlled environment, ensuring their safety and reducing human-wildlife conflicts. • The project aligns with the state's broader goal of **wildlife conservation**, public awareness, and sustainable tourism development.
